title: Tabby's Star
content:
§lTabby's Star§r, often abbreviated to §oTabby's§r, is a large F-type star in the constellation of Cygnus, in a binary system with a red dwarf star called §dBoyiajian§r. Tabby's is an artificial star composed of computronium that supports a superintelligent entity known as the §bTabby Superintelligence§r; the star was built approx. 120 million years ago by an advanced alien civilisation called the §aCygnus civilisation§r, informally known as the "swan men".

The unusual dimming events caused by the fluctuating processing occuring in Tabby's Star were noted by astronomers as far back as the §cearly 21st century§r.
